description: Re-sends the drafted request from inside the attached authoring browser (not from this machine) and checks that its selectors extract the target data points. Captured secrets stay server-side and are not returned. Returns diagnostics. Run it before `run_proof`. With `withoutSecrets: true`, sends the request with no cookies or auth headers, like an anonymous visitor. If the values still extract (`valid: true`), the endpoint is public and the proof would not bind to the user: choose an auth-bound request instead. A 403 that survives one retry and one correction is a site defense, not a recipe bug: stop retrying and publish from the capture (how_it_works({ topic: "prove" })).
name: replay_request
